scope: Illustrative geometry and declared design assumptions only. No vacancy, title, ROW, amendment completeness, vehicle swept path or legal feasibility certification.
verification: Two candidate approaches independently re-evaluated in each case, including rejected alternatives. The baseline retains two reference concepts; the declared-access study may retain fewer. Polygon-derived floor totals, plan containment, ramp exclusion from stalls/aisles, no failed implemented assumption checks on accepted candidates and overall legal status remaining unknown are asserted.

checks.title: Declared ground-ramp entrance separation
checks.explanation: Source clause99 ground-level ramp starts at least the reference distance from the building/vehicle mouth. This declaration is separate from platform length and from clause89 intersection spacing; one measurement cannot satisfy all three.

checks.title: Aligned straight-ramp reservation
checks.explanation: A bounded rectangle search places the declared run plus intermediate landings wholly inside the common service reserve of every parking level. It cannot consume stalls or aisles. A failed search is not proof that every ramp design is impossible.

checks.explanation: A bounded rectangle search places the declared run plus intermediate landings wholly inside the common service reserve of every parking level. It cannot consume stalls or aisles. The reservation does not create a slab opening or verify gradients at crests, structure, usable core space, turning or legal entrance connection. A failed search is not proof that every ramp design is impossible.

checks.title: Vehicle turning and ramp transitions
checks.explanation: A straight-run reservation or curved-ramp inner radius does not supply a vehicle swept path. A design vehicle with wheelbase/overhang, actual entry-to-stall and ramp trajectories, crest/sag sections and clearances is required. No universal turning radius or transition length is invented.
